strings.string: Use the login of the Dexcom app that is sharing (not a follower's). In the Dexcom app, Share must be on with at least one follower invited. Phone numbers need + and the country code (e.g. +491701234567). Outside the US, set Region to "Outside the US". If login still fails, enter your account ID instead of the username: sign in at uam2.dexcom.com (outside US) or uam1.dexcom.com (US) and copy the long code from the page address.
Username, email, phone or account ID
